Madhvendra Pratap Sharma, just 13 years old, is clearly one of India's biggest young talents. He took on Aravindh Chithambaram, a super GM and one of India's top players at the first round of the Chola Chess GM Open 2026. Check out this amazing encounter along with commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
